label: VERIFIED
extraction: Agent Team Work Zone treats each agent as a human employee with durable per-agent 'workstation' directories on disk containing state, skills, hooks, and scripts. Central design: agents stay ephemeral (no change to Claude Code runtime) but their reconstitution needs are written to files. Workspace layout: resources/ (skills, agents, role archetypes, scripts, hooks) and docs/ (framework manuals). Naming convention <slug>-<role> (e.g., architect-typesetter) lets idle hook derive workstation path from slug prefix. Journal-based tracking records agent work sessions with structured metadata for explainability and training data. Bootstrap step version-checks environment and syncs framework skills/agent definitions into project's .claude/ creating or merging settings rather than overwriting. Provides continuity, recoverability, and audit trail for long-lived agent teams spanning many sessions.
